rules.name: hero_clearance
rules.rule: Keep a 3.5m minimum readable combat footprint around boss and major encounter anchors.

rules.name: navigation
rules.rule: Use landmark silhouettes and repeated rune markers to communicate route direction.

rules.name: story_density
rules.rule: Story props cluster near meaningful locations and thin out on traversal corridors.

rules.name: repetition
rules.rule: Rotate, scale and variant-swap repeated dressing while preserving biome consistency.

rules.name: performance
rules.rule: Instance repeated dressing and assign LOD2/impostor policy beyond the gameplay read distance.
